newsitem.title: CHINA: China city bans sale of Opium perfume.
newsitem.headline: China city bans sale of Opium perfume.

text.p: Authorities in a city in southwest China have banned the sale of the French perfume Opium because the name undermines socialist morality, the Guangxi Daily said in an edition seen in Beijing on Friday.

Officials of the Industrial and Commercial Administration in Chengdu, capital of Sichuan province, seized Opium perfume on sale at a shopping centre in mid-August and banned the perfume, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
"Opium pour Homme" is manufactured by Yves Saint Laurent.
China's trademark law bans the sale of goods detrimental to socialist ethics, the newspaper said.
The word "opium" brings back humiliating memories of the 1839-1842 Opium War, which imperial China lost to Britain, forcing it to cede Hong Kong.
